prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal vertical 4:5 low-key projection portrait of an adult woman in a matte black sleeveless high-neck top and dark denim jeans. She has long dark hair with a soft fringe, subtle smoky eyes, glossy lips, and natural skin texture. Pose her in a three-quarter self-embrace, slightly right of center, with a calm mysterious gaze. Use a pure black seamless studio and project an oversized realistic full moon behind her head and shoulders, preserving crisp crater detail and a hard-edged shoulder silhouette shadow on the moon. Light with a single hard projector key and minimal fill; retain deep blacks, controlled highlights, sharp eyes, subtle film grain, and no text or branding.
